parrafo.es: Remocion de arboles, poda y recorte, desraizado de tocones y limpieza tras tormentas para casas en Miami y el condado de Miami-Dade. El mismo equipo que sube a rescatar un gato atrapado a mitad de la noche. Trabajo constante que sostiene la calificacion de 4.9 en Google.
parrafo.en: Tree removal, pruning and trimming, stump grinding and storm cleanup for homes across Miami and Miami-Dade County. The same crew that climbs out at midnight to rescue a cat stuck in a tree. Steady, careful work that backs up the 4.9 rating on Google.

hero.imagen_alt: Bucket truck lift reaching into tall royal palms over a residential street for a trimming job by Prestige Tree Service

parrafo_1.es: Prestige Tree Service atiende casas en Miami y el condado de Miami-Dade: remocion de arboles, poda en altura, desraizado de tocones y limpieza tras tormentas. Camion con canasta, grua y equipo de escalada segun lo que pida el trabajo, trabajando cerca de techos, cercas y lineas electricas.
parrafo_1.en: Prestige Tree Service works on homes across Miami and Miami-Dade County: tree removal, aerial pruning, stump grinding and storm cleanup. Bucket truck, crane or climbing gear, matched to what the job needs, working close to roofs, fences and power lines.

parrafo_2.es: Ese mismo equipo y esas mismas cuerdas responden tambien cuando un gato queda atrapado en lo alto de un arbol o un techo, de dia o de madrugada. Esa disposicion a aparecer cuando se le necesita sostiene la calificacion de 4.9 en Google, con 126 resenas reales.
parrafo_2.en: That same gear and those same ropes also answer the call when a cat gets stuck high in a tree or on a roof, day or well past midnight. Showing up when it matters is what holds up the 4.9 rating on Google, backed by 126 real reviews.

eyebrow.es: Tu arbol o tu emergencia, paso a paso
eyebrow.en: Your tree or your emergency, step by step

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesita tu arbol, tu terreno o tu mascota. La linea esta abierta las 24 horas, los 7 dias de la semana, al (786) 344-8923.
texto.en: Tell us what your tree, your lot or your pet needs. The line is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, at (786) 344-8923.

texto.es: Miramos el arbol, su tamano y lo que hay alrededor (techo, cercas, cables) antes de dar el costo.
texto.en: We look at the tree, its size and what is around it, roof, fences, power lines, before giving you the cost.

texto.es: Camion con canasta, grua, desraizadora o escalada con cuerda, segun lo que pida el trabajo y el espacio disponible.
texto.en: Bucket truck, crane, stump grinder or rope and saddle climbing, whichever the job and the space call for.

titulo.en: A cleared site when we finish

texto.es: Retiramos troncos, ramas y desechos: el terreno queda despejado, con opcion de reciclaje y acarreo.
texto.en: We haul off trunks, limbs and debris, with recycling and hauling built in, so the property is left clear.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el arbol, su tamano y el terreno. Llama y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the tree, its size and the terrain. Call and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Remocion controlada con camion de canasta o grua, cerca de techos, cercas y lineas electricas.
texto.en: Controlled removals with a bucket truck or crane, working close to roofs, fences and power lines.

texto.es: Poda de palmas y arboles de sombra con equipo propio, para dar forma y quitar ramas en riesgo.
texto.en: Palm and shade tree pruning with our own equipment, to shape trees and take down hazardous limbs.

texto.es: Desraizado de tocones con maquina, para dejar el terreno listo para sembrar o pavimentar.
texto.en: Machine stump grinding, so the lot is ready for new planting or paving.

texto.es: Limpieza de ramas caidas tras tormentas y rescate de gatos y mascotas atrapadas en arboles o techos, las 24 horas.
texto.en: Downed limb and storm cleanup, plus 24 hour rescue of cats and pets stuck in trees or on roofs.

pie.es: Tienes un arbol que te preocupa, un tocon que estorba o una mascota atrapada? Llama y lo revisamos.
pie.en: Have a tree that worries you, a stump in the way, or a pet stuck up high? Call and we will take a look.

items.quote: I can't thank this company enough! They went above and beyond when they rescued our kitten that was stuck 120 feet up in a tree late at night.

Renee and his crew are amazing! They are efficient and very competent. He has trimmed trees close to the roof and he is surgical with his chainsaw and that there has never been an issue. He can handle big and small jobs.
Excellent customer service and quality work. My husband was skeptical of someone I found online but after meeting and talking to Rene he was reassured by his professionalism and fair prices.
